Assessment and planning

Full GEO audit of your website and brand visibility

A full GAEO audit includes up to 100 prompts, up to 11 AI platforms, a 25–35-page report and a business-specific GEO action plan. Turnaround: 3–5 working days.

RUB 29,900

One-time service

  • Up to 100 prompts and 11 AI platforms
  • A 25–35-page report

Request an audit

The decision this audit helps you make

A full audit helps you define the scope and priorities of GEO work before starting monthly promotion. I examine the business, its products and its constraints: which services matter, who makes the buying decision, what has already been published and what the team can change on the website.

The audit covers up to 100 prompts and up to 11 AI platforms. It takes 3–5 working days and produces a 25–35-page report. The prompt matrix follows the objective: a specialized service and a store with several product categories require different groups of questions.

Examining answers and their sources

I begin with buyer questions about choosing a product, business or expert. I then examine brand presence, competitors, the nature of each recommendation and the sources used by the AI platforms. A mention of your name and a recommendation to contact your business are recorded as different observations.

The website review considers business and service information, page structure and connections between materials. I compare these with external profiles and publications. Findings are linked to specific issues, such as missing facts, an unclear description of the offer or a lack of supporting evidence.

BMR and Share of Voice methodology →Investigating the sources behind AI answers →

Turning findings into a plan

The deliverable includes a GEO action plan connecting the identified issues with website, content and external-source work. We determine the order of implementation and responsibilities: which tasks your team will handle and which GAEO will take on.

The plan reflects your industry. An online retailer needs to understand product and seller selection; a service business needs clear specializations, commercial terms and evidence of experience. Relevant methodologies explain which pages and facts are useful to the actual buyer.

Measuring product and seller recommendations →Investigating legal-service recommendations →Explore industry approaches →

Preparation and ongoing work

To start, share your website, priority products or services, target market, principal competitors and objectives. Existing publications, research and case studies are useful when they support business claims. Restrictions on website changes are taken into account in the plan.

After the audit, you can choose promotion with briefs for your team or a format that includes GAEO content creation. With a promotion contract lasting at least 6 months, the audit fee is credited against the first 3 months of work. The credit arrangement is recorded in the contract.

FAQ

Questions about this service

What are the scope and turnaround?+
Up to 100 prompts and up to 11 AI platforms, completed in 3–5 working days. The 25–35-page report includes a business review and a GEO action plan.
Is the audit a one-off or a monthly service?+
The full GEO audit is a one-off service. Monthly promotion is agreed separately after we discuss objectives, scope and responsibilities.
What if we cannot change our website quickly?+
Explain those constraints during the initial discussion. I account for the available publishing options, your team and external sources when proposing the sequence of work.
Is the audit fee credited towards promotion?+
For a promotion contract lasting at least 6 months, the audit fee is credited against the first 3 months of work. The terms and credit arrangement are set out in the contract.
